scope.summary: Included every manifest-declared benchmark source required to parse the workspace during the release-image build while keeping undeclared local benches excluded.

entry_points.name: release-image context and runtime smoke
entry_points.trace: At prior source e725cc70, the runtime image build failed while parsing crates/oraclemcp-db/Cargo.toml because benches/classify_type.rs was absent from the deny-all context. At fixing source 4ac4b441, `tests/container_supply_chain_contract_test.sh --context` passed with 217 reviewed files, all three declared bench targets present, and an undeclared local bench sentinel excluded. `docker buildx build --target runtime --load` then completed, and the resulting image passed UID 10001, XDG config/state, JSON-info, and MCP initialize smokes.

limitations: The proof used a local exact-source Docker build; no hosted registry publication or pull was exercised.
This scoped evidence cannot mark a release ready.
